name: farl_wflw_448
license: Code: MIT (facer (c) 2022 FacePerceiver; FaRL (c) Microsoft Corporation). Weights: published in the facer GitHub release with no separate weight licence (repository licence MIT). Training data: backbone pre-trained on LAION-Face 20M (web images from LAION-400M; LAION-Face id list CC-BY 4.0, images keep their original copyrights), fine-tuned on WFLW (WIDER FACE images, CC BY-NC-ND). RESTRICTION FLAG: fine-tuning data is non-commercial (NC-ND); commercial deployment of these weights needs legal clearance or retraining on licensed data.

params.kps_crop: similarity (least squares) of 5 kps onto facer standard points ([[196,226],[316,226],[256,286],[220,360.4],[292,360.4]]/256-1)*0.8, mapped to [0,447]
params.box_crop: square side max(w,h) centred on box -> 0.8*448 px (FaRL WFLW protocol, HRNet center/scale box)
params.decode: soft-argmax over the 112x112 sigmoid heatmap (FaRL heatmap2points) -> crop px -> inverse affine
params.backbone: FaRL ViT-B/16 (LAION-Face20M), FPN from blocks 3/5/7/11; head mmseg UPerHead (TorchScript)
